text:
emma: Planning to create release/1.13 on Wed 2026-03-25 15:00 UTC. Need branch owner + final backport asks by Tue EOD. Who can take the cut?
raj: I can create the branch. Will do pre-cut checklist and tag in release notes. Any blockers?
mike: I'll handle CHANGELOG and version bump. @emma any specific notes for changelog format? prefer bullets with PR numbers.
sophia: Working on backports — please comment on PRs that must land. Reminder: only critical bugfixes and docs after cutoff.
ben: Quick question: are security fixes allowed post-cut with fast-track? what's policy?
emma: Yes, security patches can be fast-tracked. File a PR marking 'release/patch' label and ping on this thread.
release-bot: pre-cut-ci: smoke-tests ✅, perf-tests ✅, docs-lint ❌ -> docs-lint failing 2 files (see link) https://ci.example.com/195123
harper: I'm picking up the docs-lint now, will push fix in ~30m.
raj: Branch creation command I'll run at cut: ```git checkout -b release/1.13 main && git push origin release/1.13``` Also will open PR template with cut checklist.
harper: Small cherry-pick request: PR #2789 (model-serving: fix kv cache miss) — safe to pick? cc @sophia
sophia: Looks safe, tested locally. Please add `cherry-pick: release/1.13` label and link to original PR review notes.
emma: Assigning tasks: @raj will cut, @mike changelog + version bump, @sophia lead backports, @harper docs fix. If anyone else has a critical backport, comment now.
raj: I'll post a branch tag in repo and add rollback instructions: ```git tag -a release-1.13-cut -m 'cut 1.13' && git push origin release/1.13 --tags```
mike: Changelog draft pushed to docs/repos/releases/1.13.md — please review. I'll bump package.json once branch exists.
harper: :thumbsup: pushed docs fix, CI re-ran, docs-lint ✅
release-bot: pre-cut-ci: all checks passing ✅. Ready for cut window.
emma: Thanks all. Final reminder: cutoff Tue 18:00 UTC for non-critical PRs. Official cut Wed 15:00 UTC. I'll post update 10m before.
